market_question: Will Solana dip to $20 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Solana has a history of 90%+ drawdowns (e.g., $260 to $8 in 2022). The timeframe includes a potential bear market in 2026, making a drop to $20 plausible if the cycle turns after a 2025 peak. The market-implied 9.5% seems to underprice this tail risk, as even a moderate 85% decline from a hypothetical $200 high would reach $30, leaving room for a wick to $20.
evidence_points: Solana reached an all-time low of ~$8 in December 2022 after a 97% drawdown from its peak.
Typical crypto market cycles often see altcoins decline 90-99% during bear phases, which would cover a drop to $20 from a 2025 bull market top.
The resolution window spans over a year (Nov 2025–Dec 2026), enough for a full cycle shift, and only requires a single 1-minute low to touch $20.
